description:
Give `dev/tools/tuning-campaign-support` one non-timed arm smoke that every campaign harness uses, so a runner-to-arm wire defect surfaces in a working session and no harness carries a private copy of the runner's wire.

## Background

A timed campaign reaches its arms only inside a benchmark window, and a wire defect there costs the window slot. The invoker rules (2026-09-18) that every arm smoke is non-timed: a smoke that drives `benchmark-ab-runner run` executes timed pilot windows and is a timed run. Four harnesses answer that with private drivers that each re-declare the runner's request, child dispatch and result parsing: `logical-campaign smoke` under `dev/active/2037941f-profile-and-optimize-mid-range-buffer-operations/survey/harness`, `qc-arm-smoke` under `dev/active/f63a2464/survey/arms`, `gf256-axpy-smoke` under `dev/active/ad2a6a58/survey/axpy-arm` and `arm-smoke` under `dev/active/c04dd4ac-zen3-shifts-and-permutations/survey/arm-smoke`. Code review of 9fb40c83 blocks that duplication under `@/invariant/convention-convergence` and `@/invariant/library-first-generality`: a private round-trip test cannot bind a private mirror to the real runner. The invoker rules that a shared smoke adds no protocol, receipt or addendum version and stays inside the epic's provenance freeze.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `tuning-campaign-support` exposes one library entry point and one `benchmark-ab-runner` subcommand that take a saved runner plan and drive every arm of every declared cell once, using the same request type, request encoder, fresh-child sentinel, child environment, child dispatch and result parser the timed `run` path uses, with no second declaration of any of them.
- [hard] REQ-02: The smoke is non-timed by construction: it requests an untimed validation dispatch, takes no host lock, opens no ledger, writes no stage, checkpoint or receipt, emits no timing sample, and fails an arm that reports a timing window. The timed `run` and `finalize` paths keep their behavior, and every committed receipt re-evaluates to its committed verdict.
- [hard] REQ-03: The validation dispatch is part of the one arm-request contract the runner declares: an arm built on `dev/active/6c6b09b1/survey/arm-common` and an arm with its own request mirror both serve it, and a contract test fails when the runner's request and an arm-side mirror disagree in field set, order or the omission of absent optional fields.
- [hard] REQ-04: The smoke's record states only facts observed at run time or derived from the plan: per cell and arm the arm name, role, executable digest, declared cache state, route provenance the arm reports and a window count of zero. Two consecutive runs over one build reproduce it byte for byte.
- [hard] REQ-05: Tests cover a conforming arm, an arm that reports a timing window, an arm that exits without a result line, a malformed result line and a plan naming an undeclared cell; each failure names the cell and the arm.
- [hard] REQ-06: The c04dd4ac harness uses the shared smoke and its private `survey/arm-smoke` driver is removed, with `survey/runner-smoke.txt` and `shift-profile-smoke.json` regenerated by their generator. The closed bb769456 logical harness converges in the same way when its producing-input closure check and its contract tests stay green; otherwise the obstacle is reported to the lead with the owning issue for that convergence named.
- [hard] REQ-07: Rustdoc and the tools' usage text state the smoke's contract once, in present tense, and every harness document cites that statement instead of restating it.

## Notes

ad2a6a58, f63a2464, 18a87159 and 4c1e441f hold queued campaigns whose worktrees pin their current trees; their private drivers converge on this smoke in their own post-window rounds, and 00dd43c3 starts on it. This task changes no file under those issues' directories. Follow `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/worker-brief.md`.
title: Provide one shared non-timed arm smoke in the campaign tools
